title: Research: admit nonunit triadic queries with a sharp local child tariff
body:
PR2593 explicitly excludes odd moduli divisible by 3 from its one-child triadic query lowering. This contribution supplies that missing branch and proves the exact local interchange-child tariff: zero children when k=0 modulo m, one when k is a unit, and two otherwise, for every odd m in the fixed ordered-affine / CHILD_C(0,5) alphabet. A one-child word must have a unit top-right matrix entry; a sum of two units attains every remaining residue. For the triadic family, the concrete split is ±2^j + ±2^(j+1), using the unchanged predecessor words.

The complete six-field ADDRESS identity and arbitrary dirty DATA endpoint are preserved. On multiples of 3 greater than 3, the literal fused pair costs 6 children, 36 affine events and 2 XOR scans, versus 8/48/4 for the separately completed pair using the same adapter. Modulus 3 gives the identity endpoint; coprime moduli retain the predecessor's 3/18/2 counts. Only the individual query's child count is proved optimal. No global fused optimum, measured runtime saving, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

Sources are retained PR840 and exact PR2593 head `77041f2d139276115ffa32ab876455d3a58ef2cb`, authenticated by SHA256 and Git blob before execution. Main was refreshed to `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9`, with guidance revision 5 and the family expansion gate read. The milestone is a local module; TASK records a narrow-and-stop decision until a named consumer and complete allowance justify further work. Physical preparation, routing, tape, precision, hosting and consumer costs remain unknown and are not assigned zero.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triadic-nonunit-lowering
python3.12 -I -O -B research/triadic-nonunit-lowering/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/triadic-nonunit-lowering/independent.py
```

The primary checks 5,250 classifications, 42,000 full matrix columns, 110 signed triadic cases and all 2,125,764 ADDRESS columns for the four signed query powers on `(Z/9)^6`, then composes every dirty DATA target/source/spectator column and inverse. Ten semantic controls pass. A separate implementation checks 1,074 full integer matrices and 111,520 triangular double-coset products. Two Git-free optimized exports and seven source/CLI corruption controls pass. A separate Codex agent reviewed the proof/model and independently replayed both scientific commands on CPython 3.12.7 with no blocking finding. Finite tests validate implementation; the written proof establishes the all-size statement.

The overlap screen covered 815 open PRs and 1,277 Discussion records plus 100 recent open PRs and the current source head. The contribution extends the explicitly excluded arithmetic branch; it does not claim a new pair-fusion identity or a defect in PR2593.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, tests and writing, including separate AI review; no independent human or proof-assistant review claimed. Credit Wentao Li / VictorLiwentao (PR840/PR2593), Karl Appel / applecrusher (PR521), commdata2338 (PR677), and the retained OpenAI tape framework. The triangular invariant and CRT are standard; new material is Apache-2.0 and frozen notices are preserved. Open next questions concern whole-program child sharing and a fully priced native consumer.
